public_rationale: OpenAI reported about 97% success on the τ2-bench telecom tool-agent benchmark on August 7, 2025, but that aggregate score does not isolate intent understanding [e1]. METR's July 2025 evaluation, published August 7, found more bugs and fewer completed features on a small set of naturally specified product tasks; it did not separate misunderstood intent from execution failures [e2]. CLARITY, published April 24, 2026, found ambiguity-resolution weaknesses and improvements from examples and metadata in generated database tasks [e3]. These evaluations do not jointly establish independently confirmed user intentions, isolate interpretation errors, and apply representative practical acceptance criteria, so they do not settle the forecast [e1, e2, e3].
limitations: Overall task scores and incomplete implementations do not establish how often GPT-5 misunderstands users [e1, e2].
CLARITY's generated database tasks do not establish sufficient reliability across assistant applications or real-user populations [e3].

from_speaker: People building things like virtual assistants and agents
cannot reliably enough map user language onto user intentions
our_interpretation: The surrounding paragraph makes original-GPT-5-based assistants and agents the target.
The plain reading concerns correctly identifying a user's intended task, constraints, and desired actions well enough for practical deployment.
Intent interpretation must be distinguished from execution, planning, coding, or tool failures after the intent has been correctly understood.
Clarifying questions are permitted; the claim does not require guessing intentions that the user has not communicated.
Reliably enough means meeting practical task requirements, not perfect performance on every request.
criteria.support_condition: Representative GPT-5 assistant evaluations isolate intent-mapping errors against user-confirmed or independently validated intentions and show that these errors prevent meeting practical application requirements.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Representative GPT-5 assistants meet practical application requirements in evaluations against independently established user intentions, including ambiguous requests and clarification.
